title: ID0424489-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2/RN300000003004] Display Defect
description:
Location Spar Ebergassin
Reported behaviour/issue:
Customer complains about a display defect. It is a fault with the display that was not present before. The charger in question is a Sicharge D 180, which was in stock at HQ (CRS) at the time -> thus we assume it is the HALO effect. The glass has no damage from the outside. Please confirm that we are allowed to replace the display and that the costs will be reimbursed.
Solution:
yyyy-mm-dd:
23.05.2025: Update

I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0424489
for a defect visible on the HMI. I also received your picture, showing that the defect is getting larger.
I already got in touch to our Quality department, and at first glance it looks like a visualization problem of the HMI.
We would like to know, if this "bubble" on the HMI is visible also when the HMI is off, or if it is visible only when the HMI is on.
